RecognizeAdvanced.title: High-Precision Full-Text Recognition
RecognizeAdvanced.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Full-text Recognition (Premium Edition) is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud. It intelligently detects all fields contained in an image, integrating multiple capabilities such as table recognition, rotation recognition, and rare character recognition to deliver a high-value, multi-scenario text recognition experience. * Based on DAMO Academy's powerful AI technology and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over years of development and offers key advantages including service stability, ease of operation, real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Multifunctional Marshaling | Integrates multiple features such as table recognition, rotation recognition, and rare character recognition into one solution. | | Interference Resistance | Supports accurate recognition across multiple layout formats, complex document backgrounds, and varying lighting environments. | | Automatic Artifact Removal | For documents containing seals or fingerprints, the system can erase seals before performing recognition. | | Advanced Capabilities | Supports features such as overlay text editing, low-confidence filtering, and pattern detection. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [General Text Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test this feature’s recognition performance via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=general#intro). | | 2 | Purchase the [Full-text Recognition Premium Edition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0719%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeAdvanced?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to retrieve the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, your Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see: [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image; more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but this may affect accuracy. Whenever possible, use high-definition images without glare or distortion.
|
RecognizeAdvanced.responseParamsDescription:
#### Response Parameter Guide
|Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |angle|int|The angle of the image (returned when NeedRotate=true). 0 indicates upright orientation, 90 indicates rotated right, 180 indicates upside down, and 270 indicates rotated left.| |content|string|Aggregated text blocks detected in the image.| |figure|list|Graphic information in the image (returned when OutputFigure=true).| |prism_wordsInfo|list|Text block information.| |prism_tablesInfo|list|Table information (returned when OutputTable=true).| |prism_paragraphsInfo|list|Paragraph information (returned when Paragraph=true).| |prism_rowsInfo|list|Line information (returned when Row=true).| |prism_wnum|int|Number of detected text blocks; equal to the size of the prism_wordsInfo array.| |height|int|Height of the image after algorithmic correction.| |width|int|Width of the image after algorithmic correction.| |orgHeight|int|Original height of the image.| |orgWidth|int|Original width of the image.| #### Text Block Information (prism_wordsInfo field) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |angle|int|Angle of the text block.| |height|int|Height of the text block (taking the text block’s angle into account).| |width|int|Width of the text block (taking the text block’s angle into account).| |pos|list|Coordinates of the four corners of the bounding rectangle of the text block, listed clockwise (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left). When NeedRotate=true, if the top-level angle is non-zero, the coordinates become accurate only after rotating the image according to that angle.| |word|string|Text content of the text block.| |tableId|int|Table ID (returned when OutputTable=true).| |tableCellId|int|Cell ID within the table (returned when OutputTable=true).| |charInfo|list|Character-level information.| #### Character Information (charInfo field) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |word|string|Single character text.| |prob|int|Confidence level.| |x|int|X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.| |y|int|Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.| |w|int|Width of the character.| |h|int|Height of the character.| #### Table Information (prism_tablesInfo field; returned when OutputTable=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |tableId|int|Table ID, corresponding to the tableId in prism_wordsInfo.| |xCellSize|int|Number of cells along the horizontal axis in the table.| |yCellSize|int|Number of cells along the vertical axis in the table.| |cellInfos|list|Cell information.| #### Cell Information (cellInfos field) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |tableCellId|int|Cell ID within the table, corresponding to the tableCellId in prism_wordsInfo.| |word|string|Text within the cell.| |xsc|int|Abbreviation for xStartCell, indicating the starting horizontal cell index (0-based).| |xec|int|Abbreviation for xEndCell, indicating the ending horizontal cell index (0-based). If both xsc and xec are 0, the text occupies one cell horizontally and is located in the first cell.| |ysc|int|Abbreviation for yStartCell, indicating the starting vertical cell index (0-based).| |yec|int|Abbreviation for yEndCell, indicating the ending vertical cell index (0-based).| |pos|list|Cell position, with coordinates of the four corners listed clockwise: top-left (x, y), top-right (x, y), bottom-right (x, y), bottom-left (x, y).| #### Paragraph Information (prism_paragraphsInfo field; returned when Paragraph=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |paragraphId|int|Paragraph ID, corresponding to the paragraphId in prism_wordsInfo.| |word|string|Paragraph text.| #### Line Information (prism_rowsInfo field; returned when Row=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |rowId|int|Line ID, corresponding to the rowId in prism_wordsInfo.| |word|string|Line text.| #### Graphic Position Information (figure field; returned when OutputFigure=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |type|string|Graphic type. Possible values: blicense_title (business license title), national_emblem (Chinese national emblem), barcode (barcode), qrcode (QR code), face (human face), finger_print (fingerprint), signature (signature), round_stamp (circular seal), oval_stamp (oval seal), rectangular_stamp (rectangular seal), square_stamp (square seal), rhombus_stamp (rhombus seal).| |x|int|X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the graphic.| |y|int|Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the graphic.| |w|int|Width of the graphic.| |h|int|Height of the graphic.| |box|object|Graphic coordinate information: center (x, y), width, height, and clockwise rotation angle. This definition matches OpenCV’s RotatedRect. For details, see the [OpenCV documentation](https://docs.opencv.org/3.4/db/dd6/classcv_1_1RotatedRect.html#a6bd95a46f9ab83a4f384a4d4845e6332).| |points|list|Coordinates of the four corners of the graphic (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left).|

RecognizeAirItinerary.title: Air Travel Itinerary Recognition
RecognizeAirItinerary.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Air Itinerary Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product that recognizes key information from air itineraries, such as passenger name, ID number, e-ticket number, verification code, issue date, sales office code, carrier, issuing office, fare, taxes, and fuel surcharge. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud OCR products have been refined over years to offer stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Electronic invoices (air transport e-ticket itineraries) are currently not supported. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Multi-type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including blurry images, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-accuracy Recognition | Overall recognition accuracy can reach 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Bill and Voucher Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test this feature’s recognition performance via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=air_itinerary#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Bill and Voucher Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0981%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing. Alternatively, you may skip purchasing a resource plan, and the system will automatically charge you based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeAirItinerary?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the recognition result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, your Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on authorization, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, OFD, and PDF formats.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
  • Excessively small images reduce recognition accuracy. Best results occur when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image File Size |
  • The binary file size must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Large files may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Related Capabilities |
  • [Air Itinerary Recognition on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00035385.html?#sku=yuncode2938500001).

RecognizeAllText.summary: The OCR Unified Recognition API recognizes multiple image types, such as general text, ID cards, and invoices. Specify the image type using the Type parameter. You do not need to switch APIs.

schema.title: Image URL (up to 2048 bytes; base64 not supported)
schema.description:
- Specify either Url or body. Do not specify both or leave both empty.

- The image URL. Maximum length is 2048 bytes. Base64 encoding is not supported.

schema.title: Binary byte stream of the image, up to 10 MB
schema.description:
- Specify either Url or body. Do not specify both or leave both empty.

- The binary image file. Maximum size is 10 MB.

- When calling via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP request body.

- When calling via SDK, place the image in the SDK body.

- The image type. This is a required and single-select parameter.

- Supported image types are listed in **Additional information about request parameters**.

- Note: For ID card or invoice images, if the actual image type does not match the specified **Type**, recognition fails.

schema.title: Whether pattern detection is required (disabled by default)

- Enable pattern detection. If enabled, the response includes the FigureInfo field (see **Response parameters**).

- true: enable; false: disable.

- Default value: varies by **Type**. See **Additional information about request parameters**.

- Supported patterns:

  - blicense\_title: business license title

  - national\_emblem: national emblem

  - face: face

  - finger\_print: fingerprint

  - signature: signature area

- Note: Enabling this increases response time. Enable only when needed.

- Enable QR code detection. If enabled, the response includes the QrCodeInfo field (see **Response parameters**).

- true: enable; false: disable.

- Default value: false.

- Note: Enabling this increases response time. Enable only when needed.

- Enable barcode detection. If enabled, the response includes the BarCodeInfo field (see **Response parameters**).

- true: enable; false: disable.

- Default value: false.

- Enable seal detection. If enabled, the response includes the StampInfo field (see **Response parameters**).

- true: enable; false: disable.

- Default value: false.

- Note: Enabling this increases response time. Enable only when needed.

- By default, no coordinates are returned.

- Return original image coordinates. The system processes the image (for example, auto-rotation or correction). Set this to return coordinates relative to the original image or the processed image.

- true: enable; false: disable.

Set this parameter for mixed invoices, VAT invoices, fixed-amount invoices, air itineraries, train tickets, roll tickets, or common printed invoices (that is, when Type=MixedInvoice/Invoice/QuotaInvoice/AirItinerary/TrainTicket/RollTicket/CommonPrintedInvoice).

schema.description: Response schema
schema.title: Schema of Response

SubImageCount.description: The number of sub-images in the image.

SubImages.description: Information about sub-images in the image.

Type.description: The sub-image type (for example, **ID card front** or **VAT invoice**).

Angle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the sub-image (range: 0–359 degrees).

SubImagePoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the sub-image (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

SubImageRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the sub-image (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

KvInfo.description:
- Structured information for the sub-image.

- This field returns structured information for ID cards, invoices, and other similar documents. For example, for an ID card, this field includes fields like Name and Gender.

KvCount.description: The number of key-value pairs in the structured information.

Data.description:
- The text content of the structured information. This is a dictionary where the **key** is the field name and the **value** is the recognized result.

- The structured fields vary by **Type**. See **Additional information about response fields** for all **Type** values.
Data.example:
{
  "address": "XX省XX市XX街道XX号",
  "ethnicity": "汉",
  "sex": "男",
  "name": "王XX",
  "idNumber": "XXX",
  "birthDate": "2000年1月1日"
}

KvDetails.description: - Detailed structured information. This is a dictionary where the Key is the field name and the Value is the recognized result (including the field value, coordinates, and confidence level).

additionalProperties.description: - Description of the structured information detail **Value**.

KeyConfidence.description: The confidence level of the field (range: 0–100).

Value.description: The text content of the field value (**KeyName**).

ValueConfidence.description: The confidence level of the field value (range: 0–100).

ValuePoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the field value (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

ValueRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the field value (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

ValueAngle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the field value (range: 0–359).

BlockInfo.description:
- Text block information for the sub-image.

- This field is returned when **Type** is **Advanced**, **General**, **MultiLang**, **Commerce**, or **HandWriting**.

BlockCount.description: The number of text blocks in the sub-image.

BlockDetails.description: Detailed text block information for the sub-image.

BlockAngle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the text block (range: 0–359).

BlockContent.description: The text content of the block.

BlockConfidence.description: The confidence level of the text block (range: 0–100).

BlockPoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the text block (returned when **OutputCoordinate="points"**).

BlockRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the text block (returned when **OutputCoordinate="rectangle"**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CharConfidence.description: The confidence level of the character (range: 0–100).

CharPoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the character (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

CharRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the character (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

RowCount.description: The number of rows in the table.

ColumnCount.description: The number of columns in the table.

CellCount.description: The number of cells in the table.

items.description: - The content of a single-line header.
- The content of a single-line footer.
items.example: "贷款人/抵押权人（盖章/电子签章）："

RowStart.description: The starting row number of the cell. The first position is **0**.

RowEnd.description: The ending row number of the cell. The first position is **0**. **RowStart=0** and **RowEnd=0** means the cell occupies only the first row.

ColumnStart.description: The starting column number of the cell. The first position is **0**.

ColumnEnd.description: The ending column number of the cell. The first position is **0**. **ColumnStart=0** and **ColumnEnd=0** means the cell occupies only the first column.

BlockList.description: The list of text block IDs in this cell.

CellPoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the cell (returned when **OutputCoordinate="points"**).

CellRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the cell (returned when **OutputCoordinate="rectangle"**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CellAngle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the cell (range: 0–359).

TablePoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the table (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points"**).

TableRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the table (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle"**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

TableExcel.description:
- The file link for the Excel export of table recognition results.

- Expires after one hour.

TableHtml.description:
- The file link for the HTML export of table recognition results.

- Expires after one hour.

RowInfo.description: Row information for the sub-image (returned when **AdvancedConfig.OutputRow=true**).

RowCount.description: The number of rows in the sub-image.

RowDetails.description: Detailed row information for the sub-image.

BlockList.description: The list of text block IDs in this row.

ParagraphInfo.description: Paragraph information for the sub-image (returned when **AdvancedConfig.OutputParagraph=true**).

ParagraphCount.description: The number of paragraphs in the sub-image.

ParagraphDetails.description: Detailed paragraph information for the sub-image.

BlockList.description: The list of text block IDs in this paragraph.

QrCodeInfo.description: QR code information for the sub-image (returned when **OutputQrcode=true**).

QrCodeCount.description: The number of QR codes in the sub-image.

QrCodeDetails.description: Detailed QR code information for the sub-image.

Data.example: “http://www.gsxt.gov.cn/indeXXX”

QrCodePoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the QR code (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

QrCodeRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the QR code (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

QrCodeAngle.description: The rotation angle of the QR code (range: 0–359).

BarCodeInfo.description: Barcode information for the sub-image (returned when **OutputBarCode=true**).

BarCodeCount.description: The number of barcodes in the sub-image.

Type.description:
The barcode type. Supported types:

- Codabar

- Code39

- Code93

- Code128

Data.example: "1100011XXXXXX"

BarCodePoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the barcode (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

BarCodeRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the barcode (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

BarCodeAngle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the barcode (range: 0–359).

FigureInfo.description:
Pattern information for the sub-image (returned when **OutputFigure=true**). This is a dictionary where the key is the pattern type and the value is the information for that pattern type. Supported pattern types:

- blicense\_title: business license title

- national\_emblem: national emblem

- face: face

- finger\_print: fingerprint

- signature: signature area

FigureCount.description: The number of patterns in the sub-image.

Type.description: The pattern type. One of **blicense\_title**, **national\_emblem**, **face**, **finger\_print**, or **signature**.

Data.description: Pattern data (returned only if data exists).

FigurePoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the pattern (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

FigureRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the pattern (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

FigureAngle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the pattern (range: 0–359).

StampInfo.description: Stamp information for the sub-image (returned when **OutputStamp=true**).

StampCount.description: The number of seals in the sub-image.

Data.description: The seal recognition result for the sub-image. This is a dictionary where the key is the field name and the value is the recognized result for the corresponding field.

CompanyId.description: The import and export enterprise code.

TopText.description: Text that appears on the outer ring of the stamp.

StampPoints.description: The four-point coordinates of the seal (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“points”**).

StampRect.description: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the seal (returned when **OutputCoordinate=“rectangle”**).

CenterX.description: The x-coordinate of the rectangle center.

CenterY.description: The y-coordinate of the rectangle center.

StampAngle.description: The clockwise rotation angle of the rectangle (range: 0–359).

QualityInfo.description: Quality detection information for the sub-image.

IsCopy.description: Indicates whether it is a photocopy.

IsReshoot.description: Indicates whether it is a photo of a document. Only supported for ID card images (**Type=IdCard**).

CompletenessScore.description: The completeness score. Only supported for ID card images (**Type=IdCard**).

QualityScore.description: The overall quality score. Only supported for ID card images (**Type=IdCard**).

TamperScore.description: The tamper score. Only supported for ID card images (**Type=IdCard**).

DebugInfo.description: Debug information (returned only if not empty).

AlgoServer.description: The list of algorithm server information (returned only if not empty).

IsMixedMode.description: Indicates whether it is a mixed type.

KvExcelUrl.description:
- The file link for the Excel export of structured information for cards and invoices.

- Expires after one hour.

Code.description: The error code (not returned if recognition is successful).

Message.description: The error message (not returned if recognition is successful).
Message.example: illegalImageUrl

400.errorMessage: Specified parameter Country is not valid.

After activation, you receive a free quota for testing. | | 2 | Purchase an [OCR Shared Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.23043878.0.0.5f3d1287hpm7ZT&commodityCode=ocr_share_dp_cn). If you do not purchase a resource plan, the system charges you on a [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) basis based on your actual usage. | | 3 | Use the code examples in the [API Explorer](https://api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeAllText?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API. After integration, call the API to get recognition results. If you use a RAM user, the Alibaba Cloud account (root account) must grant permissions to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For instructions on granting permissions, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html) | #### Important notes | Type | Overview | | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Image format | - This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, and PDF. | | Image dimensions | - The image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
- The aspect ratio must be less than 50.
- For better recognition results, use images with both dimensions greater than 500 pixels. | | Image size | - The binary file size must not exceed 10 MB.
- Large images slow down the API response. Use images smaller than 1.5 MB and pass the image URL instead of the binary data. | | Other notes | - Ensure the entire image and its edges are fully visible within the frame.
- This feature automatically handles glare and distortion, but accuracy may decrease. Use high-definition images without glare or distortion. |

RecognizeBankAcceptance.title: Bank Acceptance Bill Recognition
RecognizeBankAcceptance.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud's Bank Acceptance Bill Recognition is an official, self-developed OCR product that identifies key information on bank acceptance bills, such as the issuance date, expiration date, bill status, bill number, drawer information, payee information, and acceptor information. * Powered by DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud’s OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer high stability, ease of use, real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API (front-side recognition only; back-side recognition is not supported yet):

#### Core Capabilities of This API |Category|Overview| |---|---------| |Image format|Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP.| |Image enhancement|Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images.| |Coverage of multiple types|Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as blurry images, images with uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds.| |High-accuracy recognition|Achieves an overall recognition accuracy of up to 98%.| #### How to Use This API |Step|Overview| |--|---| |1|Activate the [Bill Credential Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=bank_acceptance#intro).| |2|Purchase a [Bank Acceptance Bill Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20220506145928_0399%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing. Alternatively, you may skip purchasing a resource plan, and the system will automatically charge you based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model.| |3|Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeBankAcceptance?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details about authorization, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html).| ------ #### Important Notes |Type|Overview| |----|-------------------| |Image format|
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not supported.
| |Image dimensions|
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
| |Image size|
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| |Related capabilities|
  • [Bank Acceptance Bill Recognition on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57000002/cmapi00040502.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6dcb4dcdaoX2WN&innerSource=search_%E9%93%B6%E6%89%BF#sku=yuncode3450200001).
|

RecognizeBusinessLicense.title: Business License Recognition
RecognizeBusinessLicense.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Business License Recognition is an OCR text recognition product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for scenarios that require extracting key information from business licenses, such as company name, address, entity type, legal representative, registered capital, organizational form, and incorporation date. * The term "general business license" includes certificates such as the Certificate of Registration for Non-Governmental Non-Enterprise Organizations, Certificate of Registration for Legal Persons of Social Organizations, and Certificate of Registration for Legal Persons of Public Institutions. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over many years and offer several advantages: stable service, simple operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Classification | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Full-Field Recognition | Intelligently recognizes all fields present on a business license. | | Multi-Type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including those that are blurry, unevenly lit, perspective-distorted, or set against arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Text information such as enterprise or institution names and legal representatives achieves an accuracy rate exceeding 95%. Numeric information such as business license registration numbers achieves an accuracy rate exceeding 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Enterprise Credential Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience the recognition capability of this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=assets&subtype=blicense#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Business License Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn_20211103184836_0975%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota that you can use for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; in this case, the system will automatically deduct fees based on actual usage under the "[pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)" billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeBusinessLicense?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration and development. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see: [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • Ensure the entire business license content, including its edges, is fully contained within the image.
  • This capability automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but such conditions may reduce accuracy. Whenever possible, use clear, glare-free, and undistorted images.
| | Related Capabilities |
  • [Alibaba Cloud Marketplace Business License Recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi013592.html?spm=5176.730005.result.41.7fc03524S3wFYv&innerSource=search_%E8%90%A5%E4%B8%9A%E6%89%A7%E7%85%A7#sku=yuncode759200000).

RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense.title: Recognition of ICP Filing Credential for Class II Medical Devices
RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * The Alibaba Cloud Class II Medical Device Business Filing Certificate Recognition is an OCR product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for scenarios that require recognition of information such as the filing number, enterprise name, business operation mode, legal representative, and business scope from a Class II medical device business filing certificate. * Based on DAMO Academy's powerful AI technologies and massive data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer several key advantages: stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of Multiple Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including blurry images, images with uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Enterprise Credential Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience the recognition capability of this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=assets&subtype=c2_medical_device_op_record#intro). | | 2 | Purchase an [Enterprise Credential Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn_20211103184836_0131%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota that you can use for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; in this case, the system will automatically deduct fees based on your actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on authorization, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user on the Users page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small will negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best results are achieved when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image File Size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
|

Data.example: {"algo_version": "", "angle": 0, "content": "1.1技术方案设计贵公司进行防磨喷涂的锅炉均为循环流化床锅炉，作为一种新型燃烧技术，由于炉型结构和设计参数等特点，在环保性能、燃烧效率、燃料适应性、高效脱硫及灰渣综合利用等方法，具有很大的优越性。然而， CFB锅炉受热面的磨损问题十分严重，贵公司决定采用超音速电弧金属喷涂技术来解决锅炉受热面磨损问题，以减少锅炉的非计划停运。我公司技术服务组根据全国各电厂的防磨防护情况，针对锅炉运行的详细状况、工艺参数以及失效因素，并依据我公司多年来从事该行业的宝贵工程经验，经我公司技术服务组专业人员的认真分析研究，并对上述部位的防护1问题分析：锅炉卫燃带，炉膛出口处，焊缝处的磨损、减薄与气流中固体物料浓度、烟气速度、颗粒的特性硬度和流道几何形状等密切相关，而在CFB锅炉中，固体物料的浓度巨大，通常可达煤粉炉的几十倍到上百倍，并且烟气流速大，颗粒硬且棱角尖锐，因而在高速烟气的带动下，对CFB 锅炉水冷壁等受热面部位的冲刷磨损极为严重；尤其在护墙根部水冷壁部位，由于位处密相区边缘区，不但受到严重的高速高浓度含床料、燃料气流的强烈冲刷、磨损，而且存在严重的涡流效应、切割效应和离心作用。涡流效应在炉膛四角部位，由于该处形成边壁流，物料汇集此处较多，由于固体颗粒的惯性作用，局部磨损作用尤为明显，而切割效应体现在护墙根部水冷壁处，其原因是由于防护墙的顶部提供了一个平台，当焦渣以较高的速度下降到该平台时产生反弹，其中往水冷壁管侧反弹部分，对水冷壁管就产生了严重的切割效应，离心作用是由于颗粒运行时受到烟气离心作用而引起。其次还易受到高温氧化和硫酸盐及硫、硫化物的热腐蚀。水冷壁管具备了高温氧化和高温腐蚀条件，其烟气温度高，且是富氧燃烧，实践证明， 在300℃以上，管外表温度每升高50℃， 腐蚀速度增加1倍。锅炉在运行过程中受热面管表面首先发生高温氧化，表面生成Fe20s， 其次燃料灰中的Na20和K20与烟气中的SOs化合生成硫酸盐，其捕捉飞灰形成结渣和流渣，此时烟气中SOs与M2S04同管壁上的Fe20s反应生成复合硫酸盐MFe (S04) 2或MaFe (S04)3，此复合硫酸盐受高温又分解为疏松状氧化铁和硫酸盐沉积层，易被飞灰气流冲蚀带走，氧化腐蚀继续向管壁纵深进行；另外燃料中硫份，经燃烧生成的S和HeS也对管壁会产生强烈的腐蚀，与Fe反应生成FeS。", "figure": [], "height": 1128, "orgHeight": 1128, "orgWidth": 912, "prism_pagesInfo": RecognizeDocumentStructure.responseParamsDescription:
## Additional Remarks on Response Fields
```
First response format (UseNewStyleOutput=false)
angle    The rotation angle of the image. This field is returned only when NeedRotate is true. A value of 0 indicates upright orientation, 90 indicates the image is rotated to the right, 180 indicates upside down, and 270 indicates rotated to the left.
content    Aggregated text blocks detected in the image.
height    Height of the image after correction by the algorithm.
width    Width of the image after correction by the algorithm.
orgHeight    Original height of the image.
orgWidth    Original width of the image.
prism_wnum    Number of detected text blocks, equal to the size of the prism_wordsInfo array.
--------------------------Field descriptions within the prism_wordsInfo text block array--------------------------
angle    Rotation angle of the text block. This angle affects only width and height. When the angle is -90, 90, -270, or 270, the values of width and height must be swapped.
height    Height of the text block.
width    Width of the text block.
pos    Coordinates of the four corners of the bounding rectangle of the text block, listed clockwise: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
word    Content of the text block.
tableId    Present only when OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the table.
tableCellId    Present only when OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the cell within the table.
paragraphId    Returned only when Paragraph is true. Indicates the paragraph ID.
-----------------------------------------charInfo: single-character information-------------------------------------------
word    Single character.
prob    Confidence level.
x    X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
y    Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
w    Width of the character.
h    Height of the character.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------Field descriptions within the prism_tablesInfo table array---------------------------
tableId    Table ID, corresponding to the tableId in prism_wordsInfo.
xCellSize    Number of cells along the horizontal axis in the table.
yCellSize    Number of cells along the vertical axis in the table.
-------------cellInfos: cell information, including spatial topology of the cell within the entire table-----------
tableCellId    Cell ID within the table, corresponding to tableCellId in prism_wordsInfo.
word    Text content within the cell.
xsc    Abbreviation for xStartCell, indicating the starting horizontal cell index (0-based) of this cell. The first cell has a value of 0.
xec    Abbreviation for xEndCell, indicating the ending horizontal cell index (0-based) of this cell. If both xsc and xec are 0, the text occupies a single cell in the horizontal direction and resides in the first cell.
ysc    Abbreviation for yStartCell, indicating the starting vertical cell index (0-based) of this cell.
yec    Abbreviation for yEndCell, indicating the ending vertical cell index (0-based) of this cell.
pos    Position of the cell, specified as coordinates of its four corners listed clockwise: top-left (X, Y), top-right (X, Y), bottom-right (X, Y), bottom-left (X, Y).

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Second response format (UseNewStyleOutput=true)
docInfo    Document information.
layouts    List of layout information.
version    Version information of the doc-json format.
----------------------------------------Fields within docInfo----------------------------------------
pages    List of document pages.
imageWidth    Width of the page after conversion to an image.
imageHeight    Height of the page after conversion to an image.
pageIdAllDocs    Page index across all documents.
pageIdCurDoc    Page index within the current document.
----------------------------------------Fields within layouts----------------------------------------
alignment    Indent enumeration (LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT, BOTH).
blocks    List of text block information.
text    Text content.
firstLinesChars    Indent of the first line of text.
index    Reading order of the layout.
lineHeight    Average line height.
pageNum    Page number where the cell is located.
pos    Coordinates of the four corners of the bounding rectangle of the text block, listed clockwise: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
type    Layout type (title: title, table: table, table_name: table name, table_note: table note, multicolumn: multi-column text, formula: formula, contents_title: contents title, contents: contents entity, text: plain text, figure: chart, foot: footer, head: header, side: sidebar).
uniqueId    Unique ID of the layout information.
numCol    Total number of columns in the table.
numRow    Total number of rows in the table.
cells    Cell information.
```

RecognizeEduQuestionOcr.title: Question Recognition
RecognizeEduQuestionOcr.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Question Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud, designed for recognizing individual questions in scanned or photographed images. It is suitable for scenarios such as intelligent grading where question content recognition is required. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technology and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over many years and offers key advantages including service stability, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Multiple Text Formats | Supports OCR recognition of printed text and formulas. | | Image Enhancement | Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Broad Coverage of Image Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images affected by blur, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds. | | Coordinate Output | Detects the position of illustrations within questions and returns their coordinates. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Education Scene Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) service. Before and after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=question_ocr#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Question Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0111%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduQuestionOcr?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the recognition result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, your Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on how to grant permissions, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both width and height must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (width-to-height or height-to-width) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend using images with both dimensions exceeding 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down the API response. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image; more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but this may affect accuracy. Whenever possible, use clear, glare-free, and undistorted images.
|

RecognizeHandwriting.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud General Handwriting Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product by Alibaba Cloud, suitable for scenarios requiring the extraction of handwritten text from documents, such as handwritten notes, blackboard writing, and similar content. * Based on DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud’s OCR products have been refined over many years and offer key advantages including stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Multiple text forms | Supports Chinese handwriting, English handwriting, and numeric handwriting. | | Image enhancement | Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of diverse types | Supports recognition in low-quality images featuring blur, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-accuracy recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [General Text Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=shouxie#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [General Handwriting Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0249%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeHandwriting?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API into your application. After integration, invoke the API to obtain classification results. If you are using a RAM user to call the API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on granting permissions, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image format |
  • Supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small will negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best results occur when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image file size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Additional tips |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image—more text may result in slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, though this may affect accuracy. For best results, use images with high definition, no glare, and no distortion.
| | Related capabilities |
  • [Handwriting Recognition on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace](https://market.aliyun.com/apimarket/detail/cmapi00040832).
|

When NeedRotate=true and the outermost angle is not 0, the coordinates are accurate only after rotating the image according to the angle.| |word|string|Text content of the text block.| |tableId|int|Table ID (returned when OutputTable=true).| |tableCellId|int|Cell ID within the table (returned when OutputTable=true).| |charInfo|list|Character-level information.| #### Character Information (charInfo field; returned when OutputCharInfo=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |word|string|Individual character.| |prob|int|Confidence level.| |x|int|X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.| |y|int|Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.| |w|int|Width of the character.| |h|int|Height of the character.| #### Table Information (prism_tablesInfo field; returned when OutputTable=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |tableId|int|Table ID, corresponding to the tableId in prism_wordsInfo.| |xCellSize|int|Number of cells along the horizontal axis in the table.| |yCellSize|int|Number of cells along the vertical axis in the table.| |cellInfos|list|Cell information.| #### Cell Information (cellInfos field) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |tableCellId|int|Cell ID within the table, corresponding to the tableCellId in prism_wordsInfo.| |word|string|Text within the cell.| |xsc|int|Abbreviation for xStartCell, indicating the starting horizontal cell index (0-based).| |xec|int|Abbreviation for xEndCell, indicating the ending horizontal cell index (0-based). If both xsc and xec are 0, the text occupies a single cell in the first column.| |ysc|int|Abbreviation for yStartCell, indicating the starting vertical cell index (0-based).| |yec|int|Abbreviation for yEndCell, indicating the ending vertical cell index (0-based).| |pos|list|Position of the cell, specified as the coordinates of its four corners in clockwise order: top-left (x, y), top-right (x, y), bottom-right (x, y), bottom-left (x, y).| #### Paragraph Information (prism_paragraphsInfo field; returned when Paragraph=true) |Field|Type|Description| |-----|---|--| |paragraphId|int|Paragraph ID, corresponding to the paragraphId in prism_wordsInfo.| |word|string|Text of the paragraph.|

It also applies to scenarios involving recognition of information such as date of birth, place of birth, name, and ethnicity from the resident population pages of a household register. * Based on DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud’s OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer key advantages including service stability, ease of operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and automatic enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of Multiple Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as those that are blurry, unevenly lit, perspective-distorted, or have arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Personal Document Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test the recognition performance of this feature through the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=standard&subtype=household#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Personal Document Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_personalcard_dp_cn_20211018150333_0555%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota that you can use for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; in this case, the system will automatically deduct fees based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeHousehold?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For specific instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (length-to-width ratio) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, it is recommended that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
  • Excessively small image dimensions may negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best recognition performance is achieved when individual characters in the image measure between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image File Size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may affect API response speed. It is recommended to use images smaller than 1.5 MB for recognition and to invoke the API by passing an image URL.
|

RecognizeIdcard.summary: This API recognizes structured fields from both the front and back of a second-generation Chinese resident identity card. These fields include name, gender, ethnicity, address, date of birth, ID number, issuing authority, and validity period. It also supports ID quality checks, such as detecting screen captures, photocopies, completeness scores, overall quality scores, tampering indexes, and face location detection.

RecognizeIdcard.title: ID Card Recognition
RecognizeIdcard.description:
#### Scenarios - Alibaba Cloud Identity Card OCR is an official Alibaba Cloud OCR product that intelligently recognizes text from images of both sides of Mainland China identity cards, including temporary ID cards, and provides structured output. - Built on the advanced AI technology and massive datasets of Alibaba DAMO Academy, Alibaba Cloud OCR provides a stable, simple, real-time, and comprehensive service. - Sample image for this API: !\[undefined]\(https\://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01VMB4xL1kWWl9GqGNt\_!!6000000004691-0-tps-1071-532.jpg" width="70%) #### Core capabilities | Category | Overview | | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Multi-type support | Automatically distinguishes front and back sides, and recognizes minority-language layouts, temporary IDs, rare characters, images with glare, and low-quality images.![undefined](undefined" width="1000/) | | Risk detection | Detects document risks such as incomplete images, photocopies, and screen captures, and provides quality scores. | | Face detection | Locates the portrait on the ID and returns its coordinates. | | Image enhancement | Enables automatic image enhancement by default, including auto-rotation, distortion correction, and blur reduction. | #### How to use this API | Step | Overview | | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 1 | Activate the [Personal Document Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, test this feature for free in the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=standard&subtype=idcard#intro). | | 2 | Purchase an [ID recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_personalcard_dp_cn_20211018150333_0014%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing. If you do not purchase a plan, the system charges you based on actual usage through the [pay-as-you-go](~~295347~~) model. | | 3 | Refer to the code examples on the [debugging page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeIdcard?lang=SWIFT&sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API. After integration, call the API to get recognition results. If you use a RAM user, the primary Alibaba Cloud account must grant authorization. For instructions on how to create a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](~~93720~~). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on how to grant permissions, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user on the Users page](~~116146~~) | #### Important notes | Type | Overview | | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Image formats | - Supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF is not supported. | | Image dimensions | - Image width and height must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8,192 pixels.
- The aspect ratio, which is the longer side divided by the shorter side, must be less than 50.
- For best recognition results, use images with both width and height over 500 pixels. | | Image size | - The binary file size must not exceed 10 MB.
- Larger images slow down the response time. Use images under 1.5 MB and pass them by URL when you call the API. | | Country and language | - This API supports only mainland China identity cards. | | Other tips | - Ensure the entire ID, including all edges, is visible in the image.
- The system automatically handles glare and distortion. However, these factors can reduce accuracy. For best results, use clear, glare-free, and undistorted images. | | Related features | - [Mixed ID card recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00042846.html?#sku=yuncode3684600001)
- [International ID recognition](~~455939~~) |
RecognizeIdcard.responseParamsDescription:
#### Response parameter descriptions



| Field              | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------ | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| data               | object | The structured information. The front side data is in the face field, and the back side data is in the back field.                                                                  |
| figure             | list   | The location of the face on the front of the ID. This field is returned only if OutputFigure is set to true.                                                                        |
| sliceRect          | object | The coordinates of the detected sub-image.                                                                                                                                          |
| prism_keyValueInfo | list   | The coordinates of the structured information.                                                                                                                                      |
| ftype              | int    | Indicates whether the image is a photocopy. 1: Yes. 0: No.                                                                                                                          |
| warning            | object | The ID quality check information. This field is returned only if OutputQualityInfo is set to true.                                                                                  |
| angle              | int    | The rotation angle of the image. 0 indicates upright, 90 indicates rotated 90 degrees clockwise, 180 indicates upside down, and 270 indicates rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. |
| height             | int    | The height of the image after algorithmic correction.                                                                                                                               |
| width              | int    | The width of the image after algorithmic correction.                                                                                                                                |
| orgHeight          | int    | The height of the original image.                                                                                                                                                   |
| orgWidth           | int    | The width of the original image.                                                                                                                                                    |

#### Front side recognition results (face field)

| Field     | Type   | Description        |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------ |
| name      | string | The name.          |
| sex       | string | The gender.        |
| ethnicity | string | The ethnicity.     |
| birthDate | string | The date of birth. |
| address   | string | The address.       |
| idNumber  | string | The ID number.     |

#### Back side recognition results (back field)

| Field          | Type   | Description            |
| -------------- | ------ | ---------------------- |
| issueAuthority | string | The issuing authority. |
| validPeriod    | string | The validity period.   |

#### Structured coordinate information (prism\_keyValueInfo field)

| Field     | Type   | Description                                                                                                                  |
| --------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| key       | string | The name of the recognized field.                                                                                            |
| keyProb   | int    | The confidence score for the field name.                                                                                     |
| value     | string | The value of the recognized field.                                                                                           |
| valueProb | int    | The confidence score for the value.                                                                                          |
| valuePos  | list   | The coordinates of the four corners of the field in the original image (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, and bottom-left). |

#### Front portrait location information (figure field)

| Field  | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| type   | string | The pattern type.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| x      | int    | The x-coordinate of the top-left corner of the portrait.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| y      | int    | The y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the portrait.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| w      | int    | The width of the portrait.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| h      | int    | The height of the portrait.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| box    | object | The portrait coordinate information: center coordinates (x, y), width, height, and clockwise rotation angle. The definition is the same as RotatedRect in OpenCV. For more information, see the [OpenCV documentation](https://docs.opencv.org/3.4/db/dd6/classcv_1_1RotatedRect.html#a6bd95a46f9ab83a4f384a4d4845e6332). |
| points | list   | The coordinates of the four corners of the portrait (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, and bottom-left).                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

#### ID quality check results (warning field)

| Field             | Type  | Description                                                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| isCopy            | int   | Indicates whether the image is a photocopy. 1: Yes. 0: No.                                                        |
| isReshoot         | int   | Indicates whether the image is a screen capture. 1: Yes. 0: No.                                                   |
| completenessScore | float | The completeness score.                                                                                           |
| qualityScore      | float | The overall quality score.                                                                                        |
| tamperScore       | float | The tampering index. A higher value indicates a greater likelihood of tampering. The recommended threshold is 60. |

It is suitable for scenarios that require extracting key information from VAT invoices, such as the total amount including tax, invoice code, and invoice number. * Powered by DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer advantages including stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. RecognizeJanpanese.responseParamsDescription:
Return Data Description
``` angle The orientation angle of the image. 0 indicates upright, 90 indicates rotated right, 180 indicates upside down, and 270 indicates rotated left.
content Aggregated text blocks detected in the image.
height Height of the image after correction by the algorithm.
width Width of the image after correction by the algorithm.
orgHeight Original height of the image.
orgWidth Original width of the image.
prism_wnum Number of detected text blocks, which equals the size of the prism_wordsInfo array.
-------------------------Field Descriptions in the prism_wordsInfo Text Block Array-------------------------
angle Orientation angle of the text block. This angle affects only width and height. When the angle is -90, 90, -270, or 270, the values of width and height must be swapped.
height Height of the text block.
width Width of the text block.
pos Coordinates of the four corners of the bounding rectangle of the text block, listed clockwise: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. When NeedRotate is true and the outermost angle is not 0, the coordinates become accurate only after rotating the image according to the angle.
word Text content of the text block.
tableId Present only when OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the table.
tableCellId Present only when OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the cell in the table.
----------------------------------------charInfo Character-level Information-----------------------------------------
word Single character text.
x X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
```
