RecognizePassport.title: International Passport Recognition
RecognizePassport.description:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud International Passport Recognition is an OCR product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud, suitable for scenarios such as immigration and customs inspection, domestic and international identity verification, and any other use cases requiring passport information extraction. * Powered by DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer key advantages including stable service, ease of operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Classification | Overview | |---|---------| | Multi-country passports | Provides recognition services for passports from multiple countries and regions, including the United States, France, the United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, and others. | | Image enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and automatic enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of multiple types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as those that are blurry, unevenly lit, affected by perspective distortion, or set against arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-accuracy recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Personal Document Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test the recognition performance of this feature via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=standard&subtype=passport#intro). | | 2 | Purchase an [International Passport Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_personalcard_dp_cn_20211018150333_0624%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; the system will automatically charge you based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizePassport?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, your Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on how to assign this policy, see [Authorize a RAM user on the Users page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small will negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best results are achieved when individual characters in the image measure between 10 and 50 pixels in height.
| | Image size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may slow down API response times. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Related capabilities |
  • [Alibaba Cloud Marketplace Passport Recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi016682.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.47e98a21paGIxa&innerSource=search#sku=yuncode1068200007).
|

Description of returned data

width Width of the image after correction by the algorithm.

orgWidth Original width of the image.
prism_wnum Number of detected text blocks, equal to the size of the prism_wordsInfo array.
-------------------------Field descriptions within the prism_wordsInfo text block array-------------------------
angle Rotation angle of the text block. This angle affects only width and height. When the angle is -90, 90, -270, or 270, the values of width and height must be swapped.
height Height of the text block.
width Width of the text block.
pos Coordinates of the four corners of the bounding rectangle of the text block, listed clockwise: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. If NeedRotate is true and the outermost angle is not 0, the coordinates become accurate only after rotating the image according to that angle.
word Text content of the text block.
tableId Present only if OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. tableId indicates the ID of the table.
tableCellId Present only if OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the cell within the table.
----------------------------------------charInfo character-level information-----------------------------------------
word Single character text.
x X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
y Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
w Width of the character.
h Height of the character.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------Field descriptions within the prism_tablesInfo table array--------------------------
tableId Table ID, corresponding to the tableId in prism_wordsInfo.
xCellSize Number of cells along the horizontal axis in the table.
yCellSize Number of cells along the vertical axis in the table.
------------cellInfos cell information, including spatial topology of the cell within the entire table---------
tableCellId Cell ID within the table, corresponding to tableCellId in prism_wordsInfo.
word Text content within the cell.
xsc Abbreviation for xStartCell, indicating the starting horizontal cell index (0-based) of this cell. The first cell has a value of 0.
xec Abbreviation for xEndCell, indicating the ending horizontal cell index (0-based) of this cell. If both xsc and xec are 0, the text spans one cell horizontally and resides in the first cell.
ysc Abbreviation for yStartCell, indicating the starting vertical cell index (0-based) of this cell. The first cell has a value of 0.
yec Abbreviation for yEndCell, indicating the ending vertical cell index (0-based) of this cell.
pos Position of the cell, specified as coordinates of its four corners listed clockwise: top-left (X, Y), top-right (X, Y), bottom-right (X, Y), bottom-left (X, Y).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

RecognizeThai.responseParamsDescription:
Return Data Description
``` angle The rotation angle of the image. 0 indicates upright orientation, 90 indicates rotated right, 180 indicates upside down, and 270 indicates rotated left.
content Summary of text blocks detected in the image.
height Height of the image after correction by the algorithm.
width Width of the image after correction by the algorithm.
orgHeight Original height of the image.
orgWidth Original width of the image.
prism_wnum Number of detected text blocks, equal to the size of the prism_wordsInfo array.
-------------------------Field descriptions within the prism_wordsInfo text block array-------------------------
angle Rotation angle of the text block. This angle affects only width and height. When the angle is -90, 90, -270, or 270, the values of width and height must be swapped.
height Height of the text block.
width Width of the text block.
pos Coordinates of the four corners of the bounding rectangle of the text block, listed clockwise: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. When NeedRotate is true and the outermost angle is non-zero, the coordinates become accurate only after rotating the image according to that angle.
word Text content of the text block.
tableId Present only if OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the table.
tableCellId Present only if OutputTable is true and the text block lies within a table. Indicates the ID of the cell within the table.
----------------------------------------charInfo character-level information-----------------------------------------
word Single character text.
x X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
y Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the character.
w Width of the character.
h Height of the character.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------Field descriptions within the prism_tablesInfo table array--------------------------
tableId Table ID, corresponding to the tableId in prism_wordsInfo.
xCellSize Number of cells along the horizontal axis in the table.
yCellSize Number of cells along the vertical axis in the table.
------------cellInfos cell information, including spatial topology of the cell within the entire table---------
tableCellId Cell ID within the table, corresponding to the tableCellId in prism_wordsInfo.
word Text content within the cell.
xsc Abbreviation for xStartCell, indicating the starting horizontal cell index (0-based) of this cell.
xec Abbreviation for xEndCell, indicating the ending horizontal cell index (0-based) of this cell. If both xsc and xec are 0, the text spans one cell horizontally and resides in the first cell.
ysc Abbreviation for yStartCell, indicating the starting vertical cell index (0-based) of this cell.
yec Abbreviation for yEndCell, indicating the ending vertical cell index (0-based) of this cell.
pos Position of the cell, specified as coordinates of its four corners in clockwise order: top-left (X, Y), top-right (X, Y), bottom-right (X, Y), bottom-left (X, Y).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

It can quickly locate required information on waybills and improve logistics transfer efficiency. * Alibaba Cloud OCR products are built upon DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, refined over many years. They offer several key advantages: stable service, simple operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:
